id.description: Identifier of the session; the correct-response session carries the number 1

element.description: The element the session belongs to

answers.description: The choices placed in each category

selector.description: The input that made the last change; the delivery writes `Mouse`

audioStartTime.description: When auto-played prompt audio started, in epoch milliseconds

audioEndTime.description: When auto-played prompt audio ended, in epoch milliseconds

waitTime.description: Milliseconds the learner waited for auto-played prompt audio to finish

shuffledValues.description: Choice ids in the order they were shuffled for this learner, when choice order is not locked

choices.description: Identifiers of the choices placed in the category

CategorizeAnswer.description: The choices the learner placed in one category
